source: esaie-55-1 (note 88 ; eau, mains en coupe, publics de dos, estuaire, sections notées 4-5 ; axe-numerique refaite après une troisième main), fanfare-dongelberg (velours, cuivres, carrière, église aux bougies), sondage-cse et observatoire-des-cse (personnes génériques variées, sans cliché).
style: Cinematic editorial photography, soft natural light, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, calm, dignified and hopeful, modern minimal composition with generous negative space.
interdits: No beneficiary face, no child face, no emblem, no banner with lettering, no religious symbol unless the plan asks for it, no charity cliché (no outstretched begging hands, no crying people).
evite: Évite d'exposer les personnes aidées et le cliché misérabiliste : silhouettes de dos, mains, eau et lumière, au plus deux mains par image.

404.consigne: An empty wooden bench on a quiet path at dawn, a folded scarf left on it, soft mist, calm and gentle.

ouverture.consigne: Underwater view looking straight up at the calm surface of clear water at dawn, golden sun rays piercing through gentle ripples, light caustics dancing, deep blue at the bottom fading to light.
ouverture.evite: La foule ou le groupe posé.

section-fond.consigne: Macro close-up of {matieres}, a heavy fringe or cord crossing the frame, soft raking light, dark background.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of two open cupped hands of one person gently receiving {sujet}, warm morning light, dark blurred background, natural skin tones, only those two hands in the frame.
scene-metier.source: esaie-55-1 accueil-mains-eau (consigne « deux mains seulement » après la correction d'axe-numerique)

lieu.consigne: Wide estuary at dawn with calm water and lush vegetation on the shore, morning mist, soft golden light reflecting on the water, serene, no buildings, no people, no recognizable landmark.

texture.consigne: Interior of a small village hall or chapel in warm candlelight, pale stone walls, simple wooden benches, a few empty music stands, rows of lit candles, no people, no lettering.

portrait-generique.consigne: Silhouettes of a few people walking hand in hand at dusk along a riverside path, backlit by a golden sky, seen from behind, no faces.
